descGu: Random numbers ના અડધા! Practice makes perfect.
descEn: Find half of random even numbers!
descDa: Find det halve af tilfældige lige tal!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: Half of even numbers practice. Pattern: half = ÷2. Even numbers only — no remainders. Later: odd number halves (fractions).
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Halving even numbers — builds division intuition.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Halvering af lige tal — opbygger intuition for division.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Computer screen half! 1920px wide display — half = 960px each side. Coding always uses halves!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: A screen with 1920px width split in half makes two 960px parts. Screen layouts are built with halving!
teacherGuide.storyDa: En skærm med en bredde på 1920 pixels opdelt på midten giver to dele på 960 pixels. Layouts bygges tit med halvering!
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Half of a number is dividing it by 2. Let's practice rapid mental halving!
teacherGuide.scriptDa: At halvere et tal er det samme som at dele det med 2. Lad os øve os i hurtig hovedregning!
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Practice halving even numbers up to 30 to strengthen division base.
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Øv halvering af lige tal op til 30 for at opbygge et stærkt grundlag for division.
